integrity: The finite classification is reproduced by exact KKT and face-vertex checks. The global two-project statement is proved analytically. Computational code is supplied with pinned algebraic-arithmetic dependency; no independent scientific audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact binary-approval budget division results for at most three projects; four-voter enumeration does not extend to larger electorates and does not concern excludable-strategyproofness or coalitional strategyproofness. Absolute historical priority is not independently established.
title: The sharp four-voter manipulability frontier for three-project Nash budget division
